Another fragment from ENA NS 18.17a, not a direct join
Description from PGPID 15840:
Quittance from Ulla b. Tahor (or Tahor b. Ulla - his name appears in both options) to Saadia and his wife Sitt al-Husn. Signed by [Yeshuʿa?] ha-Melammed b. Avraham and the physician (ha-Rofeʾ) Yaʿaqov b. Ḥalfon. Mentions: 5 dinars; a brokerage fee (? אלגעלה) of 6 + 1/2 + 1/3 dinars; 1 1/6 dinars; ʿUlla b. Ṭahor "the absent"; four pieces of something being given as collateral to Saʿadya; a period of three months ending Ḥeshvan; Ṭahor b. ʿUlla; 1.5 "shares" in something; Saʿadya's wife Sitt al-Ḥusn; [..] b. Shelomo ha-Kohen.
